scope: Correct component function in local review text only; no PCB or test result changes.
original_description: The In3 UV output passes under the B-side 100 nF decoupler through continuous In4 reference. Its original supply and direct ground paths remain. No thermal or transient immunity qualification is inferred.
corrected_description: The In3 UV output passes under the unchanged B-side 100 nF H_DUMP_TEMP filter C1503; C1503 is not a VDD decoupler. Its pad 1 and U1501.3 share H_DUMP_TEMP and pad 2 is GND; the TH1501 connection remains one of the 21 opens. In4 reference is continuous between the new route and this analog filter. Temperature-input pickup, parasitics and thermal behavior remain unqualified.
reason: Native pad nets distinguish the H_DUMP_TEMP filter from the separate C1502 VDD decoupler; the capacitor value alone was insufficient.
